scope: Proposition 7.5 (Selection of compatible detectors) of the manuscript “Bi-Lipschitz Absorption of c0 Without a Linear Copy of c0” (preprints/Bi-Lipschitz-Absorption-of-c0-Without-a-Linear-Copy-of-c0-September-26-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 324 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 4779ddc34774d95a), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 20. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Let (mi) ⊂ Z be weakly null, meaning u(mi) → 0 for every u ∈ Z∗. Suppose Fi belong to one listed class L and |⟨Fi, mi⟩| ≥ δ > 0 (i ≥ 1). (7.7) There are a subsequence (mik ), a listed class L1, tests e Fk ∈ L1, δ1 > 0, and an integer C1 ≥ 1 such that |⟨ e Fk, mik ⟩| ≥ δ1, Lip   X k∈H ϵk e Fk   ≤ C1 for every k, every finite H, and all signs ϵk.
